messages.subject: For Bill Anderson | Life sciences, government relations and stakeholder execution
messages.body:
Dear Bayer Investor Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Bill Anderson, Chief Executive Officer.

Bayer's portfolio across pharmaceuticals, crop science and consumer health requires disciplined coordination across governments, regulators, communities and sustainability priorities. That interface closely matches the work I lead today.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory, with senior institutional engagement across complex regulated operations.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this experience might support Bayer's global affairs, stakeholder or sustainability priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Bayer.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
